scenes.summary: You arrive at the Power Plateau, the energy producing center of Valley IV. The epicenter of the disaster caused by Nefarith is near. You steel yourselves and prepare to face the final challenge of this journey.

lines.text: We've arrived. This is the ⟦key|power generation center⟧ of the UWST, the literal beating heart that keeps the entirety of Valley IV powered.
A grave threat that hangs above Valley IV. It will determine the fate of countless lives.
This is the place where we decide our victory, Endministrator.
I'm sorry that you have to endanger yourself, but ... the entirety of Valley IV needs you. We need you too.
Yes. And we must bring Tata to that place.
This is the final stretch of the road...
I'm sorry that you have to endanger yourself, but ... the entirety of Valley IV needs you. We need you too.
Don't worry. Your entire team is right by your side.
That's right. Let's go, Endmin. It's time to put an end to this.

options: The rift in the sky seems so very close...
Everyone's taken good care of me.

scenes.summary: The Originium Power Plant, symbol of humanity's pioneering efforts in Valley IV, has been captured by the Landbreakers. You must go through this place to reach the Æther Test Site.

lines.text: This is the ⟦key|UWST Originium Power Plant⟧. It has stood for many years, and serves as the symbol of humanity's pioneering efforts in Valley IV.
We must make our way through the Power Plant to reach the Æther Test Site... That is where the rift is located.
One stands as the past of Valley IV, the other a symbol of its future. They are both important to the UWST.
But right now, they're both facing a serious threat.
I see signs of damage all over the place. Those breakers must have launched a major assault on this power plant.
With an attack force this size, the crew can barely hold them off.
We must assume the worst, team. Expect hostile forces in this facility.

options: The Power Plant and the Æther Test Site...
Director Qin mentioned these two places.

scenes.summary: Inside the Originium Power Plant, you find signs of battle all around. Many of the facilities have been damaged, and several Landbreakers roam near the gate. After defeating them, you receive a radio message from an unfamiliar male voice.

lines.text: Hello...? Do you copy? ...What the ... suck a ...
Was that a radio message? Someone's trying to hail us.
We should be cautious. An unidentified signal is trying to get into our internal channel. Chen, I need you to secure our perimeter.
Those breakers are here as well! Things aren't looking too good for the people inside.

scenes.summary: After the radio call with Crowe, you hold a short discussion. You then decide to head to the location he provided to continue your investigations.

lines.text: Could it be a trap?
No. It doesn't seem like something that the Bonekrushers would do. Fiona, anything from voice fingerprinting and analysis?
There's a match with the files that UWST synced with us. We're certain that the caller is indeed ⟦key|Matz Crowe⟧ himself.
I agree... I believe we should indeed meet him face-to-face. Perhaps we'll find other UWST survivors there.
And we have the coordinates, right? Let's go.

options: He warned us. It sounds serious.
